enchantment.maledicta.curse_of_karma.des: The attacker will receive the same amount of damage as the victim.
Instead of causing harm, the attacker will heal the target.
enchantment.maledicta.curse_of_randomnes: Each time the item loses durability, its enchantments will be shuffled, except for curses.
enchantment.maledicta.curse_of_fleeting_: A portion of drops become untouchable and disappear shortly.
enchantment.maledicta.curse_of_doom.desc: The player dies shortly after having too less health.
